Priya: Heads-up: p99 jump for /v2/generate (eu-west) ~21:30. p50/p95 stable. noticed sample_count for that slice dropped ~3x. suspect routing fallback to lowmem pool.
Samir: I saw it. compat-lowmem got more weight and that pool emits downsampled telemetry. tdigest rollups will look weird for tails.
Janelle: Is the dashboard backing p99 from tdigest rollups or raw-event queries? need to know how to respond.
Priya: Dashboard uses tdigest rollups. Query is basically tdigest_percentile(rollup_tdigest,0.99) + sum(sample_count).
Alex: Downsampling + tdigest = brittle tails. Short-term options: (A) show provenance + low-confidence badge when samples < N, (B) provide an on-demand raw-p99 compute, (C) tweak routing so lowmem only gets background traffic.
Samir: Start with provenance UI and a confidence heuristic. Expose sample_origin in rollups and mark p99 low-confidence when samples < 200 or origin != "raw". Offer a button to compute raw p99 for that time slice.
Janelle: I'll mock a compact badge next to percentiles: shows source, count, and a tooltip that links to the raw compute action. Will post mock morning.
Alex: Also there's inconsistent telemetry tagging (routing_policy vs route_variant) across producers. let's standardize the tags before we rely on provenance. I'll open a tiny schema RFC.
Priya: I'll run a small canary: toggle telemetry.downsample=false for compat-lowmem at 10% for 30m to confirm sampling artifact.
ops-bot: rollout started by Priya: config.telemetry.downsample=false for route compat-lowmem (canary=10%).
Samir: If canary reverts p99, we document the tdigest caveat + add UI confidence. If not, dig deeper into KV cache hotpaths.
Priya: Will post before/after graphs and tenant ids from the canary in ~30m. Ping me if you want the raw sample extractor API sooner.
